briefings.title: Waymo Co-CEO Dmitri Dolgov: The Demo Is Only 1% Of The Work
briefings.tldr: Building physical AI requires bridging a massive gap between a working demo (1% of the work) and a reliable real-world product (the remaining 99%), demanding rigorous safety frameworks, multi-sensor hardware redundancy, and closed-loop simulation.

briefings.title: The 20-year journey to fully autonomous cars with Dmitri Dolgov of Waymo
briefings.tldr: Waymo has transitioned from a 20-year scientific research phase to a massive global scaling operation, now delivering 500,000 autonomous rides weekly by utilizing a unified AI backbone that distills massive off-board foundation models into specialized on-board "drivers."
